newsitem.title: FRANCE: Usinor sees slight drop in H1 1997 results.
newsitem.headline: Usinor sees slight drop in H1 1997 results.

text.p: Privatised steel group Usiner Sacilor expects a very slight drop in its first-half results, chairman Francis Mer said on Monday.
"The first-half result will not be very far away from the same period last year, a little bit lower," he said.
He did not say which part of the company's results he was referring to.
The second half should be better, however, he told a shareholders' meeting.
In the first half of 1996, Usinor posted a net atributable profit of 833 million francs, down from 2.36 billion in the first six months of 1995.
Its full-year net attributable profit was 1.49 billion francs, down from a record 4.43 billion in 1995, the year in which it was privatised.
Mer said higher spot metal prices, having an immediate impact on the group's accounts, and better economic conditions would lead to improvement in the second half of this year.
